import json, subprocess, sys, time, resource
AL='abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789-_'
def big(i):
    # 62-char label x 4 = wire 4*63+1 = 253
    lbls=[]
    x=i
    for _ in range(4):
        lbls.append(''.join(AL[(x//(36**k))%36] for k in range(8))*7)  # 56 chars
    return '.'.join(lbls[:3]+[''.join(AL[(x%36)]*62)])+'.'
recs=[]
for zi in range(16):
    zr=[]
    for j in range(64):
        owner = 'o%d.%d.z%d.' % (j, zi%7, zi)
        t = ['A','AAAA','TXT'][j%3]
        d = {'A':'192.0.2.%d'%(j%256),'AAAA':'2001:db8::%x'%j,'TXT':'T'*200}[t]
        zr.append({'owner':owner,'type':t,'data':d})
    recs.append({'origin':'z%d.'%zi,'records':zr})
# cname chain of 60
for i in range(60):
    recs[0]['records'].append({'owner':'c%d.z0.'%i,'type':'CNAME','data':'c%d.z0.'%(i+1)})
profiles=[{'id':'p%d'%i,'max_aliases':64,'cname':'follow','wildcard':'rfc'} for i in range(8)]
queries=[{'id':'q%d'%i,'name':'c0.z0.','type':'A','cost':1} for i in range(10)]+[
         {'id':'r%d'%i,'name':'o3.3.z5.','type':'TXT','cost':2} for i in range(10)]
obs=[]
for i in range(64):
    ans=[{'owner':'c%d.z0.'%k,'type':'CNAME','data':'c%d.z0.'%(k+1)} for k in range(128)]
    obs.append({'id':'ob%d'%i,'query':'q%d'%(i%10),'profile':'p%d'%(i%8),
                'result':{'status':'response','rcode':'NOERROR','answer':ans}})
doc={'zones':recs,'profiles':profiles,'queries':queries,'observations':obs}
raw=json.dumps(doc).encode()
print('bytes',len(raw))
t=time.time()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=raw,capture_output=True,timeout=120)
el=time.time()-t
print('elapsed %.2f'%el,'rc',p.returncode,'outlen',len(p.stdout))
u=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
print('maxrss child MB', u.ru_maxrss/1024)
out=json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
print('runs',len(out['runs']),'audits',len(out['audits']),'diag',json.dumps(out['diagnostic'])[:150])
print('sample run', json.dumps(out['runs'][0])[:300])
